method.sampling: last moving-path frame, every 0.5 s, exact first same-colour board frame
method.roi: bounding rectangle of last path center and all same-colour first-board centers, expanded by 65 px
method.colour_component_policy: same HSV masks and 20 px² minimum as E019 10 Hz probe; preserve all components

limitations: The source-reviewed prefixes, moving paths and first partial boards are same-agent development evidence, not independent physical identity ground truth.
ROI geometry uses the later same-colour board proposals and can include unrelated stones; component count is a visibility diagnostic, not an association decision.
A single colour component does not establish the same physical stone, particularly between sparse 0.5-second samples or during collisions.
ROI and HSV settings were developed on this source. No transfer, metric accuracy, physical F1, complete game state or simulation readiness follows.
